title: P0-4r runtime-action-executor: Add ActionExecutor trait + 3 §19 mock actions (NOT a dispatch stub fix)
description: Feature P0-4r (revision of black-hat-rejected vb-01vkw). Black-hat review round 1 found that the original 'ActionRegistry::dispatch is a stub' framing was fabricated. ActionRegistry::dispatch at crates/vb_runtime/src/action.rs:122-194 IS already implemented: it resolves the compile-time contract, validates the action ID matches, and returns ActionOutcome::Suspended(ticket) via dispatch_generic (line 182-194). The file is 212 lines total. This bead is NOT a dispatch fix. It IS adding a new layer: the ActionExecutor trait (master §19) that wraps the existing ActionRegistry::dispatch and provides 3 mock actions (Echo, ComputeHash, Delay) for the verify and simulate pipelines. The new trait is at crates/vb_runtime/src/action.rs:200+ (in the empty space below dispatch_generic). Master §19: the executor trait is the single entry point for verify+simulate to call mock actions without depending on the full Runtime. The 3 mocks: EchoAction (returns the input bytes as ActionOutcome::Suspended(ticket)), ComputeHashAction (Blake3 of the input), DelayAction (sleeps for an input-specified duration then returns). Kani harness: prove ActionExecutor::execute never panics on any ActionInput. proptest: 1000 random (input, contract) pairs all produce ActionResult<Suspended>.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL expose a public ActionExecutor trait that the verify and simulate subcommands can call without depending on the full Runtime
THE SYSTEM SHALL provide at least 3 mock actions (Echo, ComputeHash, Delay) implementing the ActionExecutor trait

event_driven.trigger: WHEN ActionExecutor::execute is called with an ActionInput whose contract matches a registered mock
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return ActionResult<ActionOutcome::Suspended(ticket)> with the ticket's payload field set to the mock's output

event_driven.trigger: WHEN ActionExecutor::execute is called with an ActionInput whose action is not registered
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return ActionError::UnknownAction { action: input.action } (preserved from ActionRegistry::dispatch)

unwanted.condition: IF a mock action's input exceeds the contract's byte limit
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT panic; it must return ActionError::InputTooLarge
unwanted.because: Master §19: actions are capacity-bounded; exceeding the limit is a typed error, not a panic

preconditions: ActionRegistry::dispatch is already implemented and tested (this bead does NOT touch it)
The new ActionExecutor trait lives in crates/vb_runtime/src/action.rs (additions go after line 194)
postconditions: ActionExecutor trait is public and importable from vb_runtime::action
EchoAction, ComputeHashAction, and DelayAction each implement ActionExecutor
A default ActionExecutor::execute delegates to ActionRegistry::dispatch for any action it does not handle natively
invariants: ActionExecutor::execute preserves the byte-limit invariant from validate_input_bytes
Mock actions are pure functions: same input → same ticket payload (deterministic for Echo and ComputeHash; Delay is timing-dependent but ticket creation is deterministic)

edge: proptest_action_executor_round_trip: 1000 random (action, input, contract) triples; assert no panics and the result type matches the truth table
kani_action_executor_does_not_panic_on_any_input: bounded model check with 3 actions and 5 contract sizes (15 combinations)

security_failures.prevention: Mock actions are explicit (Echo, ComputeHash, Delay); the ActionRegistry contract check rejects unknown actions before execute is called
